versions.subject: Create win_root_certificate_installed.yml
versions.detection:
condition: 1 of them
selection1:
    Image|endswith: '\certutil.exe'     # Example: certutil -addstore -f -user ROOT CertificateFileName.der
    CommandLine|contains: '-addstore * root'
selection2:
    Image|endswith: '\CertMgr.exe'      # Example: CertMgr.exe /add CertificateFileName.cer /s /r localMachine root /all
    CommandLine|contains: '/add * root'
selection:
    EventID: 4104
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
      - 'Import-Certificate * Cert:\LocalMachine\Root'
      - 'Move-Item * Cert:\LocalMachine\Root'
versions.spl: (Image="*\\certutil.exe" CommandLine="*-addstore * root*") OR (Image="*\\CertMgr.exe" CommandLine="*/add * root*") OR (EventID=4104 ScriptBlockText IN ("*Import-Certificate * Cert:\\LocalMachine\\Root*", "*Move-Item * Cert:\\LocalMachine\\Root*"))
